_comment: Chronicler's deployment-specific metric names. The server registers these only when UNITARES_METRICS_CATALOG_EXTRA points at this file (see docs/operations/resident-roster.md); the core catalog in src/fleet_metrics/catalog.py stays product-only. Every name in agents/chronicler/scrapers.py SCRAPERS must be in the core catalog or here, or its daily POST is refused.

metrics.name: tokei.unitares.src.code
metrics.description: Lines of code (excluding comments/blanks) in unitares/src/ — Python only.

metrics.name: tests.unitares.count
metrics.description: Number of `test_*.py` files in unitares/tests/ — rough proxy for test-surface breadth.

metrics.name: governance.sentinel.findings.7d
metrics.description: Sentinel findings (incl. forced-release alarms) in the last 7 days, from durable audit.events. Tracks how much the analytical resident is flagging over time.

metrics.name: github.cirwel.traffic.views.14d
metrics.description: GitHub page-view count summed across non-archived CIRWEL repos. GitHub traffic API rolling 14-day window; not daily delta.

metrics.name: github.cirwel.traffic.views.uniques.14d
metrics.description: GitHub unique-visitor count summed across non-archived CIRWEL repos. GitHub traffic API rolling 14-day window; not daily delta.

metrics.name: github.cirwel.traffic.clones.14d
metrics.description: GitHub clone count summed across non-archived CIRWEL repos. GitHub traffic API rolling 14-day window; not daily delta.

metrics.name: github.cirwel.traffic.clones.uniques.14d
metrics.description: GitHub unique-cloner count summed across non-archived CIRWEL repos. GitHub traffic API rolling 14-day window; not daily delta.
